title.zh: 登录态四语言 21 天质量验收报告

purpose.en: Publish the administrator Project record for the September 2 signed-in production acceptance after all required real-user evidence was collected.
purpose.zh: 在全部必要的真实用户证据完成后，发布 9 月 2 日登录态生产验收的管理员 Project 记录。

en: English passed Course, Play, SmartCard Practice, Challenge, Rankings, Score History, and Everyday Speaking; planned 2 minutes, measured 2 minutes 31 seconds, deep focus Reading, Sprint score 80/100, and the signed-in score and learning logs persisted.

Japanese passed Course, Play, SmartCard Practice, Challenge, Rankings, Score History, and Everyday Speaking; planned 3 minutes, measured 3 minutes 2 seconds, deep focus Vocabulary, Sprint score 80/100, and the signed-in score and learning logs persisted.

Spanish passed Course, Play, SmartCard Practice, Challenge, Rankings, Score History, and Everyday Speaking; planned 4 minutes, measured 4 minutes 4 seconds, deep focus Reading, displayed Sprint scores 60/100 and 80/100, and the signed-in score and learning logs persisted.

Italian passed Course, Play, SmartCard Practice, Challenge, Rankings, Score History, and Everyday Speaking; planned 1 minute, measured 1 minute 58 seconds, deep focus Listening, Sprint score 80/100, and the signed-in score and learning logs persisted.
zh: 英语通过课程、Play、智慧卡练习、挑战、排行榜、成绩历史及生活口语；计划 2 分钟，实测 2 分 31 秒，深测阅读，速成 80/100，登录态成绩与学习日志均已持久化。
日语通过课程、Play、智慧卡练习、挑战、排行榜、成绩历史及生活口语；计划 3 分钟，实测 3 分 2 秒，深测词汇，速成 80/100，登录态成绩与学习日志均已持久化。
西班牙语通过课程、Play、智慧卡练习、挑战、排行榜、成绩历史及生活口语；计划 4 分钟，实测 4 分 4 秒，深测阅读，页面显示速成 60/100 与 80/100，登录态成绩与学习日志均已持久化。
意大利语通过课程、Play、智慧卡练习、挑战、排行榜、成绩历史及生活口语；计划 1 分钟，实测 1 分 58 秒，深测听力，速成 80/100，登录态成绩与学习日志均已持久化。

en: The report covers the anonymized qa_test_learner_1 identity in the Chinese production interface on smartlingo.net for Pacific date 2026-09-02.
Payment records, the zero-point referral ledger, three existing certificates, subscription state, roles, and provider settings remained unchanged.
zh: 报告覆盖太平洋日期 2026-09-02、smartlingo.net 中文生产界面中的匿名 qa_test_learner_1 身份。
付款记录、零积分介绍人账本、原有三份证书、订阅状态、角色及服务商设置均保持不变。

en: Record real Chrome evidence for four languages without storing the test email, verification code, message body, or authentication artifacts.
Reference vocabulary-loading fix commit 8618ceacf51316d4db6c4971d2024a3a27a705c5 and successful Cloudflare deployment run 33618456522.
zh: 记录四种语言的真实 Chrome 证据，不保存测试邮箱、验证码、邮件正文或身份验证资料。
引用词汇加载修复提交 8618ceacf51316d4db6c4971d2024a3a27a705c5 与成功的 Cloudflare 部署运行 33618456522。

en: All 36 official courses expose exactly 120 prebuilt sentences; Listening and Writing each select ten unique daily items from the reviewed 4,320-row catalog.
Each language completed a real five-skill Sprint, a checked Course Writing sentence advancing 1/10 to 2/10, and a checked target-language Listening sentence advancing 1/10 to 2/10.
Challenge used the learner-local 2026-09-02 set and advanced automatically after six seconds; rankings showed the selected language on the server-derived Top 25 surface.
Repeat-after-me and user-language audio remained off throughout, and no microphone permission was requested; the normal no-microphone text and scenario paths passed.
Mika, Leo, and Aya were visibly marked as AI study partners; the AI turn-taking entry worked without enabling Nearby or sharing location.
zh: 36 门正式课程均恰好提供 120 条预建句子；听力与写作分别从已审核的 4,320 行目录选择每日十条唯一题目。
每种语言均完成真实五技能速成、课程写作正确组句并由 1/10 前进至 2/10，以及目标语言听力正确组句并由 1/10 前进至 2/10。
挑战采用学习者本地 2026-09-02 题组并在六秒后自动前进；排行榜在服务器生成的 Top 25 界面显示所选语言。
全程保持跟读和用户语言语音关闭，未请求麦克风权限；正常无麦克风文本与场景路径通过。
Mika、Leo 和 Aya 均明确标为人工智能学习伙伴；未开启 Nearby 或共享位置即可进入人工智能轮流学习。

en: Physical-device microphone scoring remains outside scheduled QA by design; no blocker remains for the required no-microphone acceptance path.
zh: 真实设备麦克风评分按设计不属于定时质量验收范围；必要的无麦克风验收路径没有剩余阻塞。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's Chinese interface, twelve-language picker, server-graded learning history, Clerk identity, Worker, D1, R2, course catalog, and strict payment/referral/certificate boundaries.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 中文界面、十二语言选择器、服务端评分学习历史、Clerk 身份、Worker、D1、R2、课程目录及严格的付款/介绍人/证书边界。
